title: 皐月賞の後に・挫折もまた良し！

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Alas, what a tragedy! Falling by the wayside on the slopes of Nakayama. Victory was out of my reach!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Tumbling off the throne I have yet to possess… The fumbling Overlord…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, but you need not worry about me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Stumbling blocks are essential to a good story! This result is not a bad one, not in the least.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't seem too discouraged. Her name is on the scoreboard, so she certainly isn't off to a bad start.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Is that… all I can do?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I was sure I could make a better time. Why…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What is that look on your face, Ayabe? Unsatisfied with the results as well, are you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: All was not in vain. Our duet whipped the Satsuki Sho crowd into an uproar, did it not?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I just… wasn't at my best.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh… Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You threw off my pace. My own weakness is to blame…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But still, if you hadn't been around…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, hatred has budded within you—as is natural for a rival.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But, Ayabe, was it really my fault that you weren't at your best?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Either way, if this anger fuels your improvement, I do not mind it in the least.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You don't know the first thing about me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I do! I know it all! You are an Umamusume who wished to prevail in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And the cause of your lapse in focus lies within your own mind.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Face your troubles as they arise, just as I face my reflection in the mirror each day.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I bid you farewell!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: How did she… see right through me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She couldn't have. I don't know…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do I need to face myself?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: O stars above, laugh at my expense for my failure to achieve victory.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It is as you had predicted—I could not win!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But how disheartened the others would be had I shined too brightly at the beginning of the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It appears the throne of the Centurial Overlord is still distant, so long as a sliver of mercy remains within my heart…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O performs her soliloquy. It seems this loss provided her inspiration for some good material.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer. We must decide on my next objective.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Where is the coming stage on which I would dance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The answer is already set. With one crown gone, we can only go after the next.
choice_data_list: It's on to the Tokyo Racecourse at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh, as I expected. Very well. I shall make the sky shine magnificently over that Classic.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe will most likely… No, she will definitely run there, bringing her own flair.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Behold, Trainer… The night sky.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That shining glimmer… It's the Derby Star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's pointing to the North Star… which now, as I've just learned, has a new name.
